evidence.title: File:Bunch of roses cake.jpg
evidence.description:
Inspired by the many bunch of flowers  cakes on hear/.  Don't know whose was the original.  But i have been dying to try  this one.
  I made it for my DH for our anniversary.  He kept asking who i was making the cake for.  I said for practice.  It was only when the tag went on that he realised it was for him ("Say it with flowers").  He never buys me flowers.   HE wnet out the next day and bought flowers lol
 
Took for ever as there are over 50 hand modelled roses.
